Design analysis · Merch & Effect

Patron bucket lightweighting

Mass reductionCapacity studyMaterial comparison

A quantified redesign study that cut estimated mass while increasing usable capacity and preserving the premium product character.

Baseline

13.1 kg estimated construction mass and 38.27 L capacity, excluding batteries and LEDs.

Option 01

6.4 kg estimated mass — approximately 51% lower — using reduced acrylic and stainless-steel thicknesses.

Option 02

4.982 kg estimated mass — approximately 62% lower — with a painted acrylic decorative skin. Capacity increased to 41.63 L.

Clean product renders recovered from the approved technical specification, supported by the physical prototype. Design estimates from the project report; they do not represent physical strength validation.

Research & mechatronics · BUE

Anthropomorphic robotic hand

Mechanical designFEA3D printingEMG control

The strongest early project in the portfolio: a five-finger mechanism taken from CAD and structural studies through 3D-printed assembly, electronics and EMG-driven control.

Mechanical system

I designed the finger mechanisms and palm around printable parts, available hardware and tendon-style actuation.

Prototype

The final report records a 327 g physical hand responding to EMG signals, with the limitations of electrodes and actuator strength documented.

Outcome

The project received 94/100 and demonstrates the hands-on link between mechanical architecture, analysis, fabrication and control.

The presentation render leads the case, with the physical prototype and original assembly drawing retained as engineering evidence.
